regions.region: top title, abstract, and graphical abstract
regions.finding: True article title and a duplicate high-level depiction of the current Pd-catalyzed naphthol/alkoxyallene transformation; the graphical abstract is not counted as a second experiment.
Three cited literature transformations (allylic alcohol derivatives, alkynes/oxidative allylation, and allenamides) are recorded as literature examples, not current-paper experiments.
One generic current-work dearomative allylic alkylation scheme; R-group drawings are retained as templates.

unresolved: The cited prior-work drawings are generic and were not expanded into concrete structures or treated as experiments from this paper.
The page advertises Supporting Information, but no SI file was explicitly provided or associated.

regions.region: Table 1 reaction drawing, ligand structures, rows 1-12, and footnotes
regions.finding: Twelve separate optimization experiments were enumerated. Rows 4 and 12 have blank yield/e.r. cells and are not converted into zero yield or no-reaction claims.
Entry 11 is reported as 81% yield, 92:8 e.r., and E/Z >19:1. The prose calls the base DBU while the table calls it TMG; both values are retained as a conflict.
Introduces Schemes 2/3 and states that 3a was assigned R by calculated ECD comparison to SI Figure S1; the unavailable SI is not inferred or used.

unresolved: Rows 4 and 12 have blank outcome cells; the source does not establish whether this means no reaction, no isolated material, or omitted data.
Entry 11 base conflict remains unresolved: TMG in the table versus DBU in the prose.
Ligand drawings L1-L5 were retained by source labels; no complete machine SMILES were asserted.

regions.region: Scheme 2 generic arrow, product drawings 3a-3u, footnote
regions.finding: One generic scheme plus 21 independent beta-naphthol substrate-scope experiments. Each row retains its isolated yield and product-specific e.r.; 3s is preserved exactly as source-reported 93:8 e.r.

regions.region: lower-left preparative-scale, reduction, and control-experiment prose
regions.finding: Corroborates Scheme 4a-e records. The scale-up prose reports 1.81 g 3a, conflicting with the 1.44 g shown on page 4; both are retained.
Reports 61% deuteration at the allene middle carbon and presents an author-proposed catalytic cycle; the proposal is not treated as experimental proof.

unresolved: The source mass conflict for the scale-up (1.81 g versus 1.44 g) remains unresolved.
Candidate product SMILES encode E geometry but leave the new tetrahedral center untagged pending expert atom-level mapping.
No complete atom-mapped reaction is claimed; bond classification is partial.
The 3s e.r. value is reported as 93:8 and was not silently normalized.

regions.region: Scheme 3 generic arrow, product drawings 5a-5f, and footnote
regions.finding: One generic scheme and six independent alpha-naphthol scope experiments. The footnote calls the 0.2 mmol substrate 1, whereas the arrow/general procedure call it 4; this label conflict is retained.
Five separate experiments: preparative scale-up, NaBH4 reduction, base-free control, methyl-ether no-reaction control, and D2O labeling. The no-reaction control has no fabricated product.
Recorded as a proposed mechanism, not as an observed mechanistic experiment.

regions.region: Experimental Section and beta/alpha general-procedure text
regions.finding: General procedures were inherited into the matching scope records: sealed tube, PO, Pd2(dba)3, TMG, (R,R)-L5, 60 °C, noble-gas protection, TLC completion, concentration, and flash chromatography.

unresolved: Scheme 3 source-label conflict (1 versus 4) remains explicit.
Scale-up mass conflict remains explicit.
Control and labeling experiments cite 'standard conditions' without fully restating every charge on the scheme; missing details were not invented.
The proposed intermediates in Scheme 5 were not asserted as isolated or directly observed species.

regions.finding: Completes the operation sequence used by Scheme 3 records; the text says 'provide 6' although the scheme labels products 5, so this wording is not used to create a new product series.

regions.region: Procedure for synthesis of alcohol and page-spanning reduction text
regions.finding: Provides explicit 3a, NaBH4, MeOH charges, 5 h at room temperature, crude 1H NMR d.r. measurement, solvent removal, and PE/EtOAc 9:1 chromatography for Scheme 4b. Heading says alcohol 6a, body says 3ab; both labels are retained as a source inconsistency.
Product masses, repeated yields, and product-specific chiral-HPLC methods were merged into the matching Scheme 2 records. NMR/HRMS/rotation data are characterization context, not separate syntheses.

unresolved: The alpha-procedure sentence says 'provide 6' while Scheme 3 products are 5a-5f.
The reduction heading says alcohol 6a while the body/scheme say 3ab.
Spectral assignments were preserved as context and were not independently checked peak-by-peak.
The general procedure says noble gas protection without naming the gas.

regions.finding: Completes the 3i minor retention time and HRMS context; this is a continuation of the existing 3i scope experiment.

Product masses, repeated yields, and chiral-HPLC methods were merged into the corresponding Scheme 2 records. The page contains no additional reaction arrow or independent synthesis beyond these continuations.

regions.region: spectral, rotation, and HRMS data throughout both columns
regions.finding: Retained as characterization context; molecular-ion values, NMR peaks, and retention times are not modeled as separate reactions.

unresolved: Spectral assignments and HRMS arithmetic were not independently verified and remain characterization context.
The 3s ratio remains source-reported as 93:8 e.r. without correction.
No claim is made that later pages or unavailable SI were semantically covered.
